description: Suggest values for one stored template's fields from source material: an uploaded DOCX or PDF, pasted text, or the stored extracted text of up to five documents picked from a matter, in any combination. Returns a suggestion per field with the snippet it came from; nothing is written to the template and no document is filled. Pass timezone so dates are anchored to your calendar day rather than the server's. Consumes AI usage.

alternative.reason: extracting from an uploaded document needs its bytes; the same call reads `text` or `entityIds` instead, which is why it stays invokable
